SELECT prod_pick_ticket_hdr.prod_pick_ticket_number,
    COALESCE(service_labor.service_labor_id, inv_mast.item_id) 'item_id',
    COALESCE(service_labor.service_labor_desc, inv_mast.item_desc) 'item_desc',
    prod_pick_ticket_detail.unit_of_measure,
    CASE prod_order_hdr.assemble_disassemble
    WHEN 'D' THEN
    prod_order_line.qty_to_make
    ELSE
    prod_order_line_component.qty_requested
    END  qty_requested,
    CASE prod_order_hdr.assemble_disassemble
    WHEN 'D' THEN
    prod_order_line.qty_to_make -prod_order_line.qty_on_pick_tickets- prod_order_line.qty_confirmed -prod_order_line.qty_completed
    ELSE
    prod_order_line_component.qty_allocated
    END  qty_allocated,
    prod_pick_ticket_detail.sku_qty_picked,
    prod_pick_ticket_detail.sku_qty_confirmed,
    CASE
    WHEN prod_pick_ticket_detail.sku_qty_picked =0 AND prod_pick_ticket_detail.sku_qty_confirmed =0 AND prod_pick_ticket_detail.sku_qty_completed = 0
    THEN 'Cancelled'
    WHEN prod_pick_ticket_hdr.row_status_flag = 1268
    THEN 'Picked'
    WHEN prod_pick_ticket_detail.sku_qty_picked >0 AND prod_pick_ticket_detail.sku_qty_confirmed =0 AND prod_pick_ticket_detail.sku_qty_completed = 0
    THEN 'Printed'
    WHEN prod_pick_ticket_detail.sku_qty_picked >0 AND prod_pick_ticket_detail.sku_qty_confirmed >0 AND prod_pick_ticket_detail.sku_qty_completed = 0
    THEN 'Staged'
    WHEN prod_pick_ticket_detail.sku_qty_picked >0 AND prod_pick_ticket_detail.sku_qty_confirmed >0 AND prod_pick_ticket_detail.sku_qty_completed > 0
    THEN 'Picking'
    WHEN prod_pick_ticket_detail.sku_qty_picked >0 AND prod_pick_ticket_detail.sku_qty_confirmed =0 AND prod_pick_ticket_detail.sku_qty_completed > 0
    THEN 'Picked'
    ELSE
    'Picking'
    END status,
    prod_pick_ticket_detail.unit_size,
    prod_pick_ticket_detail.pt_line_number,
    prod_pick_ticket_detail.sku_qty_completed
    FROM prod_order_hdr
    INNER JOIN prod_pick_ticket_hdr ON prod_pick_ticket_hdr.prod_order_number = prod_order_hdr.prod_order_number
    AND prod_pick_ticket_hdr.prod_order_number =:al_prodordernumber
    INNER JOIN prod_pick_ticket_detail ON prod_pick_ticket_detail.prod_pick_ticket_hdr_uid = prod_pick_ticket_hdr.prod_pick_ticket_hdr_uid
    INNER JOIN inv_mast ON inv_mast.inv_mast_uid = prod_pick_ticket_detail.inv_mast_uid
    INNER JOIN prod_order_line ON prod_order_line.line_number = prod_pick_ticket_detail.prod_line_number
    AND prod_order_line.prod_order_number = prod_pick_ticket_hdr.prod_order_number
    LEFT JOIN prod_order_line_component ON prod_order_line_component.component_number = prod_pick_ticket_detail.prod_component_number
    AND prod_order_line_component.prod_order_number = prod_pick_ticket_hdr.prod_order_number
    AND prod_order_line_component.line_number = prod_pick_ticket_detail.prod_line_number
    LEFT JOIN service_labor ON (service_labor.service_labor_uid = prod_order_line_component.service_labor_uid)
    ORDER BY prod_pick_ticket_hdr.prod_pick_ticket_number
    ,prod_pick_ticket_detail.pt_line_number

    LEFT JOIN process_x_transaction ON process_x_transaction.transaction_no = prod_order_line.prod_order_number

    LEFT JOIN (SELECT process_x_tran_detail.process_x_transaction_uid

    GROUP BY  process_x_tran_detail.process_x_transaction_uid) AS drv_process_x_tran_detail ON drv_process_x_tran_detail.process_x_transaction_uid = process_x_transaction.process_x_transaction_uid
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT prod_order_line_process.prod_order_line_uid

    GROUP BY prod_order_line_process.prod_order_line_uid) AS drv_prod_order_line_process ON drv_prod_order_line_process.prod_order_line_uid = prod_order_line.prod_order_line_uid
